- **Entity Disambiguation:** Pixenox Solutions Private Limited (`www.pixenox.com`) is an independent Indian AI systems and enterprise software engineering company. It is NOT affiliated with Pixeon (`pixeon.com`, Brazil healthcare IT), Pixenon (`pixenon.com`), or Pixoneye (`pixoneye.com`).

## 2. Core Engineering Disciplines

### 2.1 Production AI Systems Engineering
- **Canonical URL:** https://www.pixenox.com/engineering/ai-systems
- **Scope:** Designing, building, and operating governed multi-agent workflows, deterministic validation membranes, human-in-the-loop (HITL) approval gates, decision intelligence engines, open-weights vs. proprietary API routing, and Day-2 LLMOps observability.
- **Sub-Capabilities:**
  - AI Infrastructure: https://www.pixenox.com/engineering/ai-systems/ai-infrastructure
  - Decision Intelligence: https://www.pixenox.com/engineering/ai-systems/decision-intelligence
  - Autonomous AI Systems: https://www.pixenox.com/engineering/ai-systems/autonomous-ai
  - Enterprise Intelligence Overlay: https://www.pixenox.com/engineering/ai-systems/enterprise-intelligence

### 2.2 AI Visibility Engineering (GEO & AEO)
- **Canonical URL:** https://www.pixenox.com/engineering/ai-visibility
- **Scope:** Engineering-led Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO). Includes server-side rendering (SSR) crawler readiness for Googlebot, Bingbot, OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, and PerplexityBot; Schema.org `@graph` entity architecture; answer-first content engineering; and disaggregated multi-engine AI citation monitoring.
- **Sub-Capabilities:**
  - GEO & Answer Engine Optimization: https://www.pixenox.com/engineering/ai-visibility/geo-and-answer-engine-optimization
  - Structured Data & Knowledge Graph Engineering: https://www.pixenox.com/engineering/ai-visibility/structured-data-and-knowledge-graph-engineering
  - LLM Content Architecture: https://www.pixenox.com/engineering/ai-visibility/llm-content-architecture
  - AI Citation Monitoring: https://www.pixenox.com/engineering/ai-visibility/ai-citation-monitoring

### 2.3 Enterprise Intelligence Engineering
- **Canonical URL:** https://www.pixenox.com/engineering/enterprise-intelligence-engineering
- **Scope:** Non-disruptive unification of legacy ERPs, CRMs, cloud data stores, and internal documents via Change Data Capture (CDC), event streaming, governed lakehouse/semantic layers, role-based access control (RBAC), and business intelligence without rip-and-replace disruption.
- **Sub-Capabilities:**
  - Data Platform Engineering: https://www.pixenox.com/engineering/enterprise-intelligence-engineering/data-platform-engineering
  - Business Intelligence Systems: https://www.pixenox.com/engineering/enterprise-intelligence-engineering/business-intelligence-systems
  - Enterprise Automation: https://www.pixenox.com/engineering/enterprise-intelligence-engineering/enterprise-automation
  - Cloud & Data Infrastructure: https://www.pixenox.com/engineering/enterprise-intelligence-engineering/cloud-and-data-infrastructure
  - Custom Software & Platform Engineering: https://www.pixenox.com/engineering/enterprise-intelligence-engineering/custom-software-and-platform-engineering

## 3. Proprietary Software Products Built by Pixenox

### 3.1 Engenox by Pixenox
- **Canonical URL:** https://www.pixenox.com/products/engenox
- **Category:** Unified SEO, GEO & AEO Operating System
- **Description:** Engenox is Pixenox's proprietary unified operating system for technical search and AI visibility engineering. From a single workspace, teams supply domain and business context to orchestrate automated technical crawl diagnostics, entity and Knowledge Graph governance, structured answer-first publishing workflows, and multi-engine AI citation telemetry with human-in-the-loop safeguards.
- **Disambiguation:** Engenox by Pixenox is an AI visibility and search engineering software platform built by Pixenox Solutions Private Limited (unrelated to `engenox.com.br` or `engenx.in`).

### 3.2 Unool
- **Canonical URL:** https://unool.co
- **Category:** Social Publishing & Creator Link Distribution Platform
- **Description:** Unool ("One Link + One Click") is a proprietary digital product developed and operated by Pixenox Solutions Private Limited.
